text: Boarded ahead of schedule and the crew were warm and attentive throughout. Arrived 15 minutes early — great start to the trip.
Two-hour delay with no communication from the airline until we were already at the gate. Missed our connection as a result.
Comfortable seats even in economy, smooth flight throughout, and the meal was genuinely enjoyable. Would fly with them again.
On time but the legroom was almost non-existent on the three-hour flight. Fine for short hops, painful for anything longer.
Luggage did not arrive at destination. After three days of chasing the airline, it turned up with no apology or compensation offered.
Efficient boarding process and a clean cabin. The crew handled a slightly bumpy patch over the mountains with calm professionalism.
Best long-haul experience I have had. Flat-bed seats, exceptional food and wine, and crew who seemed to genuinely enjoy their work.
Flight was an hour late departing and the cabin was stuffy. The crew did their best but the aircraft felt dated.
Very smooth flight despite forecast turbulence. The pilot kept us informed throughout and the crew remained cheerful.
Cramped middle seat with a broken recline mechanism. Raised it with the crew who said there was nothing they could do mid-flight.
Spotlessly clean aircraft and a smooth on-time departure. The snack box was surprisingly decent for a budget carrier.
Bumpy approach into the destination but the pilot handled it well. Boarding was a little chaotic but we departed on time.
Premium economy was worth every extra cent. Wide seats, attentive crew, and a menu that surprised us on a mid-haul route.
Three-hour delay, no meal voucher offered, and a dismissive response from ground staff. Will not be booking this airline again.
Smooth departure, smooth landing, and the crew struck the perfect balance between attentive and unobtrusive. Exactly what flying should be.
